race.comment: BAUHINIAN PRAYERS (2) resumes for the leading barn and gets the key booking of Thompson. His Eagle Farm debut was better than fifth reads after he was bumped, raced wide throughout and still made inroads from well back. Has been fitted with a 1000m trial and is drawn cosy. A lot to like. BURNT ENDS (13) made an encouraging start at Doomben when beaten a long neck, on the back of two smart trials here in readiness. Is sure to have come on from that and is well placed to go a couple better. FLYING FORWARD (7) didn't make an impact on debut back in May but looks to have come on nicely during the break, stripping fitter for a neat trial on the inner surface. Wouldn't be surprised to see him in the finish. BRAVE BENNY (5) battled into fourth when resuming in town and with improvement to come he can finish in the minors.
